name: Ray-Aggregation Transformer
definition: A transformer block that aggregates features across the point dimension (Npts) along rays to produce 2D semantic-embedding fields (S_2D_rgb, S_2D_sem) for rendering.
summary: The Ray-Aggregation Transformer aggregates features along rays to jointly render RGB and semantic fields, differing from view-aggregation methods by focusing on point-wise ray processing.
